sources.display_name: Zenodo global daily mesoscale front location dataset
sources.raw_retention: server_data/raw/front_location/ only; do not commit raw NetCDF or derived fine-grained working files
sources.public_display_boundary: Public artifacts may expose front lines, cold/warm side, nodata masks, and aggregated object metadata.
sources.caveat: Front IDs exported by the prototype are local-day object identifiers, not long-term tracked fronts.

sources.display_name: Zenodo global daily mesoscale front intensity archive planned source
sources.raw_retention: server_data/raw/front_intensity/ only after storage review; do not commit raw NetCDF or extracted fine-grained grids
sources.public_display_boundary: No public artifact is available until intensity semantics, units, and display risk are validated.
sources.caveat: The source is registered for planning only. Do not infer intensity values until a validated artifact exists.

sources.display_name: NOAA GHRSST Geo-Polar Blended nighttime L4 SST
sources.raw_retention: server_data/raw/sst/ only; do not commit raw NetCDF
sources.public_display_boundary: Public artifacts may expose binned 0.5 degree C SST runs and aggregate statistics.
sources.caveat: SST is displayed as environmental context and does not by itself prove fishery activity.

sources.display_name: Global Fishing Watch apparent fishing effort planned sample
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 or confirmed project-specific license
sources.raw_retention: server_data/raw/gfw_ais/ only; do not commit API responses, 0.01 degree working grids, MMSI, vessel names, tracks, or reconstructable source data
sources.public_display_boundary: Only event-level or radius-level aggregate Front Response Table rows may be published after go/no-go review.
sources.caveat: Apparent fishing effort is estimated from AIS behavior and is not catch, production, biomass, revenue, or guaranteed fishing result.
